name: Gibb.O6
summary:
Welcome to Gibb.O6!

In this game, you use your hands to move around the Gibbon world! Explore tons of maps with friends or hang out with strangers in gamemodes!
Looking for a new look? Head on over to The Monke Store to get cosmetics that rotate every big update!

Watch out though, things aren't to friendly in the Gibbon world, rumor has it is there is a tunnel that no gibbon should enter, for you may never leave. People say they hear strange noises coming from there, so it's best to stear clear and go on
